description: Capture the Mac screen as PNG base64: the main display, display (index from mac_windows), or one window by window_id (CGWindowID from mac_windows; works when covered). A display capture can be cropped to region {x,y,w,h} in screen points as mac_windows reports them (the main display's top-left is 0,0; a display to its left has negative x), not relative to the display; with display given, a region not inside that display is refused. Returns {scale, logical_size, screen, screenshot_id}; click coordinates are in points (pixels / scale). screenshot_id (valid 30 s) lets mac_click take x,y in screenshot pixels: the window's geometry is re-checked first and a window that moved, resized or was rebuilt since the capture is refused as stale.
name: mac_screenshot
